controlled_change: Residency off versus core-cache at 1072 slots, the same 12GiB maximum, unchanged mixed artifact and arithmetic. Two screen pairs, separate state validation, then five fresh alternating pairs.
correctness: All output tokens and arithmetic dispatch counts match. Separate full-model native checks show exact logits, routes and persistent state, with fresh replay, forced eviction, cancellation, failure and recovery.
decision_origin: authored interpretation; original report statuses retained
expected_effect: Lower complete-request latency; the stage also requires median savings of at least 20ms per token in initial and append decode.
hypothesis: Requesting Metal residency for core weights and the expert cache reduces driver cost while preserving immediate expert execution.
limitations: Single M1 Pro, short 72-token initial request and 128-token retained append; no 2K/4K/7K or sustained-coding acceptance.
Production defaults remain unchanged. Paired intervals assume approximately independent log ratios; temporal host effects can violate this.
outcome: Five fresh pairs show 4.35% lower conversation latency, paired 95% interval 3.21-5.48%. Median generation changes from 3.566/3.188 to 3.796/3.309 tokens per second. All ten processes were clean. Paired median savings 22.59/11.24ms miss the append stage target. The original collector conflated a missed target with no gain; the corrected interpretation preserves the measurements and failed advancement gate.
smallest_experiment: Compare 1072 and 1460 expert slots under core-cache residency and immediate execution, admitting the same 12GiB maximum and stopping on memory disturbance.
